en.summary: Add a third reviewer: the reviewers' capacity goes from 2 to 3.
assumptions: The third reviewer works the same hours as the other two.
expected_effects: Changes may wait less before code review; a simulation will tell by how much.

zh-Hant.summary: 增加第三位審查者：審查者的容量從 2 變為 3。
assumptions: 第三位審查者的工作時間與另外兩位相同。
每次審查仍需 240 分鐘。
expected_effects: 變更在程式碼審查前的等待可能減少；模擬會說明減少多少。

sources.title: Little's law for review queues (test page)
